parameters.name: Idempotency-Id
parameters.description:
Your unique identification for a POST request 
 - Maximum length is 128. 
-  CitiConnect API responds with an error (HTTP status 4XX) if your POST request idempotency identification value is a duplicate across a recent history of idempotency identifications in Citi's database. 
- If you don't receive any response (HTTP status 2XX, 4XX or 5XX) from Citi to your POST request and you wish to retry, reinitiate your request with the same idempotency identification to prevent accidental duplicate payment.

 - For UK bank availability/reachability,this field is Mandatory with enum Value GB 
- For US EWS,this field is Mandatory with enum Value US 
- For UK,this field is Mandatory with enum Value GB 
 - For IN PAN,this field is Mandatory with enum Value IN 
 - For SEPA VoP,this field is Mandatory with enum Value 
 - For Global Master Card Validation, the method.country field is optional for World link clients when sending card validation request to CCAPI. if the method.method fiels is classified as card, its is treated as Master Card Validation by defalult and the validtion logic is applied globally it not restricted to any specific country or region

type.description:
Message type (e.g., CT for credit transfer,AER for Account Enquiry Request) 
- For US EWS,this field is mandatory 
- For UK,this field is mandatory 
- For SEPA VoP,this field is mandatory 
- For Global Master Card Validation,this field is mandatory  
- Ownership - Account ownership is limited to validation of correct owner , hence the account number or equivalent ( i.e Virtual account) and Name 
- Attributes- Attributes define the properties of the object , for an account the properties should include Status , type of account, status of account , the address of the account  etc. 
- Structure - Structure refers to the mod 97 and the length as per the country of IBAN 
- TAXID-  Validation of individual or corporate tax id/tax documentation
 - REACHABILITY - Bank is reachable on a given network 
- AVAILABILITY - Availability of a bank to receive a particular credit
